testing_gaps: Rejected and rewritten controlled values are not tested for leaving field state and validation untouched. The controlled user-change test uses an accepting setter (FieldControl.test.tsx:97-114), while the programmatic-change test covers only an accepted update (142-167).
The cancellation test asserts only that validation is skipped (FieldControl.test.tsx:189-200); it does not check whether cancellation also prevents dirty/filled changes or clearing existing errors.

Programmatic synchronization tests only an empty-to-nonempty transition (FieldControl.test.tsx:142-167). A programmatic reset to the initial empty value is not checked for clearing filled and dirty state.
